Rajnath Singh Urges SCO Nations for Unified Stance Against Terrorism

Union Home Minister Rajnath Singh, speaking at the SCO Summit, called for a unified global approach against terrorism, emphasizing that there should be no double standards in combating it. He urged member nations to take collective action to dismantle the "terror ecosystem" and stop the financing of terrorism.
